title: Carpet Stairs Mansion
description: Adds the new Red Wool Stairs into the Mansion structure
body:
# Simple Mansion update using the new Wool Stairs
Since the introduction of the **Wool Stairs** there were a lot of discussions about updating the **Woodland Mansion Structure** to use those instead of the Cobblestone.

Because I couldn't already find a datapack doing this on Modrinth, I quickly modifyed the structure files myself and here is it!
